action.description: ThrottleUpstream (flow-fed path over alarm threshold — slow upstream admission), ReassignLabor (release-fed path saturated at its WIP limit with backlog remaining — flag for headcount reassignment), or NoActionNeeded.

allOf.description: The latest labor plan Workforce Management reported for a path — a read-only projection of Workforce Management's plan.

observedAt.description: When this service last observed a ShiftPlanCommitted event for this path.

driftHeads.description: No longer computed (ADR-0049: the drift reconciliation of ADR-0019 moved to warehouse-planning with the shift plan). Present only on a path whose last observed plan was reconciled before that, until the path's next observed plan; removed in stage E. Signed: `plannedHeads` here minus the planned heads of this service's old committed PathPlan, `0` when they agreed.

driftDetectedAt.description: No longer computed (ADR-0049); see `driftHeads`. When the drift was detected, present only when `driftHeads` is non-zero.

laborPlan.description: Present only if a labor plan has been observed for this path; omitted entirely (not present as null) otherwise. Additive context, does not affect `action`.
